reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Added a new function is_range_backed_by_order() to check if a range is backed by folios of the target order, and used it in the mTHP collapse tests.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Added a new self-check for the vm_util folio-order helpers, is_backed_by_folio() and is_range_backed_by_order(), which are used by the khugepaged mTHP cases to detect collapse results.

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch series improves the coverage of khugepaged tests by addressing gaps in testing, including running at a 512M PMD size, detecting results per window rather than count, driving khugepaged deterministically, covering collapse at every supported order, and racing collapse against everything that can touch its sources.
